description: Keeps the work an agent noticed but skipped, so nothing is lost when a turn ends. Agents record follow-ups through five tools as they work, and you triage the list in a banner above the composer: push a row into the composer, hand it to a new thread, reorder it, or dismiss it for good. A dismissed row stays gone even when an agent notices the same thing again. Twelve bb follow-up subcommands cover the same ground from a terminal, and recorded rows appear in the @ menu. No background model call and no external service: the two buttons that spend a turn only run when you press them.
